verdict.rationale: Smithery's documented Triggers let an MCP server push upstream events to a consumer. That is a developer building block for event delivery, not a product feature for setting up autonomous background automations; nothing documents scheduled or recurring jobs that Smithery runs on the user's behalf. The connection services were also shut down on October 31, 2026, leaving only a public registry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
